instructions:
Code knowledge graph of this repo (Tree-sitter AST + call / import / test edges). Use it whenever the question is about RELATIONSHIPS between pieces of code, in any phase of work - coding, debugging, planning, brainstorming, refactoring, review - not only code review:
- who calls / references symbol X -> query_graph_tool pattern=callers_of / references_to
- which files import module or file X -> query_graph_tool pattern=importers_of
- which tests cover X -> query_graph_tool pattern=tests_for
- what breaks if X changes (blast radius) -> get_impact_radius_tool
- what a diff or branch touches -> detect_changes_tool, get_review_context_tool
- how modules depend on each other -> get_architecture_overview_tool, list_communities_tool
- follow an execution flow -> list_flows_tool, get_flow_tool
Graph answers include dependents reached through re-exports and barrel files that never spell the name, which text search silently misses.
For plain text - string literals, log messages, env var names, comments, config keys - use Grep; the graph does not index text.
